plans.title: Covel Commons floor 3 (Grand Horizon Room level)

source.what: Covel Commons Grand Horizon Room level floor plan (event-space diagram: Grand Horizon Room salons A to G, promenades, terrace, rotunda stairs, elevator, North Ridge, West Coast and South Bay rooms)
source.license: UCLA's own page (Housing & Hospitality); no license stated

plans.how: Walls are the dark lines of the plan image; rooms are the spaces they enclose, with door gaps closed by extending each wall end up to 2 m. The plan was fitted to the ground with a similarity transform on 7 control points (NW corner of the building (North Ridge room's NW corner); SW corner (South Bay room's SW corner); easternmost point of the terrace; NW corner of the north stair block; NE corner of the north stair block; SW corner of the south stair block; SE corner of the south stair block).

notes: The plan is UCLA Conferences & Catering's event-space diagram: room names, no room numbers, no scale, and it is schematic (the terrace is drawn larger than the mapped footprint). It is fitted with a similarity transform on seven outline points (building corners, the stair blocks, the terrace's east end); residuals up to 2.8 m.

Floor: the Grand Horizon Room is on Covel Commons' 3rd floor (UCLA International Education Office and Hill Residential Programs directions both say '3rd floor'); UCLA Space Inventory lists floor 3 rooms 300LO to 341 but no names, so no room numbers are recorded here. The site's Covel study rooms (210, 218, 225, 227, 229 on floor 2; 307, 319A on floor 3) cannot be matched to this plan.
The Grand Horizon Room's salons A to G are divided by dashed lines on the plan (movable partitions); cuts follow those lines so each salon is a space. North Ridge A/B and West Coast A/B likewise.
Kinds: the promenades and the rotunda hall are recorded as corridors, the terrace as 'other'.
